summary: The strict machine-readable private-audio receipt guard contract was persisted. A local executable validator plus 11 PASS/FAIL fixtures was constructed and passed an ephemeral local Node test, but the GitHub implementation write for the validator path was explicitly denied by the tool safety control. The denied write was not retried, redirected, or bypassed. Acceptance remains incomplete because the executable validator and durable fixtures/tests could not be published.
